notes: Zahlenschlange blanks verified from the printed number pattern ((ein)hundert, dreihunderteinundfünfzig, (ein)tausend, zehntausend, achthundertsiebenundneunzigtausend, eine Million given): 200=zweihundert, 300=dreihundert, 651=sechshunderteinundfünfzig, 100 000=hunderttausend, 898 000=achthundertachtundneunzigtausend.
7a radio answer Sie verified from the 3b dialogue on page 26 (Verkäufer says Sie kommt aus Italien) and der/das/die -> er/es/sie; Lampe -> sie field matches the printed Tisch->er, Bett->es examples.

8a checkboxes verified visually from the cartoons (bed too short for the man, chair too small, lamp price shock 999,-): Bett=zu kurz, Stuhl=zu klein, Lampe=zu teuer. Comic words transcribed manually with estimated boxes; the orange 999,- price tag is only partly legible and was excluded.
8b feedback radios (zu leicht/okay/zu schwer) are subjective - no fields. Audio markers 1.25 and 1.26-1.28 printed; all files exist (three buttons for 1.26/27/28 at the shared marker).
